changelog: v0.5 release: Fixed self-healing provider fallback loop where stale cached streams resurrected failed providers causing playback stalls, added instant waterfall failover on exhausted media/demux errors, fixed buffer byteOffset slicing in Rust zero-copy fallback, added one-tap 'Copy Log to Clipboard' button in Settings to easily share logs via WhatsApp or chat, and upgraded autoupdater to seamless one-click update and silent zero-prompt background startup update with auto-restart while preserving all user app data.
